slides.texte_overlay: ɛɞ ૮૩ tips that will make you feel 5x smarter at school

read the title and the first paragraph of tomorrow's lesson tonight.
in class, everything sounds familiar.

write one question in the margin per lesson.
your brain starts looking for answers on its own.

quiz yourself on the day's lesson in the evening, notes closed.
you'll be the one who remembers it next week.

keep a list of new words you hear in class.
using them in essays makes a huge difference.

phone out of your bedroom at night.
you sleep better and your brain actually stores what you learned.
